title: qq bot groups/list response: groups recognised from the bot's own group events, with best-effort names

groups.description: Groups the bot has seen in group events, oldest first. There is no platform API that lists a bot's groups, so this list is the only source; a group appears only after the bot received an event there.

openid.description: group_openid, usable directly in the group whitelist setting.

name.description: Group name when the platform returned one; null when it could not be read. Reading it needs a whitelisted bot, so a normal app always gets null here.

nameUnavailable.description: true when name is null. A name can be missing because the app is not whitelisted, because the lookup budget for this request ran out, or because the platform call failed.

eventType.description: Type of the most recent group event seen in this group.

firstSeenAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the first event seen in this group.

lastSeenAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent event seen in this group.

count.description: How many group events the plugin has counted for this group.

claimEnabled.description: Whether group id discovery is enabled in the stored settings. When false, no new group is recorded and this list stops growing.

recordingLimit.description: How many groups the plugin keeps in memory (ring capacity); older ones are dropped, so this is the upper bound of the list.
